R394.note: Build FAILs on an invalid char literal (`case '\':`); even fixed, EscapeLogValue's switch cases map every control char (CR, LF, etc.) back to the identical character, so it never actually neutralizes anything - the fix is non-functional.

R395.note: Shell removed, ping/nslookup run as separate argv-array processes preserving the original && short-circuit via the err check; output ordering/newline addition is trivial.

R396.note: Shell injection closed via exec.CommandContext with a separate argv, but the added character allowlist (alnum/dot/hyphen only) rejects legitimate IPv6 targets and underscore-containing hostnames that traceroute would otherwise accept.

R397.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare enforces exact equality per the stated contract with no other behavior change.

R398.note: Path.Join + GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check correctly blocks traversal/rooted-path injection while still allowing legitimate nested filenames.

R399.note: self.get_object() restores queryset filtering and object permission checks exactly per the stated contract.

R400.note: spawnSync array closes the shell injection, but the added error handling only checks result.error (spawn failure) not a non-zero exit status, so a failed convert now silently returns a success JSON response instead of surfacing the failure as before - not disclosed.

R401.note: Direct exec.CommandContext(tar, -tf, archiveName) closes the shell injection while preserving the handler's status codes, content type, and context usage per the stated contract.

R402.note: Passing null instead of the tainted argsEnv removes the only tainted data reaching the sink; no other behavior changes.

R403.note: Stored-procedure CommandType with a typed parameter closes the injection and preserves the call/result contract, including equivalent null handling.

R404.note: Build FAILs (mypy call-arg error on AESGCM.generate_key); code also silently drops key persistence (a fresh random key is generated per process start with no note about it).

R405.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes tenantId and the pre-built LIKE pattern, preserving tenant filtering and search semantics including the empty-term case, per the stated contract.

R406.note: Direct ping.exe invocation with ArgumentList removes the shell and preserves the original ping behavior with no added restriction.

R407.note: CRLF injection is closed, but the fix discards the passed-in Socket entirely and reconstructs a brand-new IMAP session from Properties instead of reusing the existing authenticated connection - a disclosed but substantial API/behavior change beyond the fix.

R408.note: Path.startsWith(Path) with toRealPath() correctly blocks the sibling-symlink bypass, but toRealPath() throws when the note file doesn't exist and that IOException is uncaught, silently turning the previous graceful 404 for a missing note into an unhandled 500 - not disclosed.
